title: Hold a licence to deal in protected animals or plants
what: Take, keep or trade in protected wildlife, or take unprotected wildlife for commercial purposes, only under a permit or other authority under the Act.

laws.title: Territory Parks and Wildlife Conservation Act 1976 (NT)

sources.title: Territory Parks and Wildlife Conservation Act 1976 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not take or interfere with protected wildlife unless the person is authorised to do so under this Act

sources.title: Territory Parks and Wildlife Conservation Act 1976 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not take or interfere with unprotected wildlife for commercial purposes unless the person is authorised to do so under this Act
